attacks.name: Pounders
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 4 or less, this character may Push it |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Shatter Mountains, Shatter Bones
steps: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

|!critical|, |!wild|, |!hit|, |!failure| |*Shatter|: After this attack is resolved, instead of inflicting the Stagger special condition, if the target character does not have an Activated token, you may give it an Activated token.

superPowers.name: Bad Manners
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of Size 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Crushing Leap
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes a |!range_small| Advance. Then this character is Placed within |!range| 2 of itself. Then this character may then make a |*Pounders| attack.

superPowers.name: Trollish Temper
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase| this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Trollhide
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage|, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
